subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Earnings Management vs Fraud
description: Learn Earnings Management vs Fraud in one minute.

hook.text: Your company missed earnings by one cent. Analysts will punish the stock. Can you 'adjust' the numbers?

buildup.text: Earnings management uses legal accounting flexibility to smooth results and meet market expectations.

discovery.text: The line between aggressive accounting and fraud is thin. Cookie jar reserves, timing tricks, and estimates blur it.

twist.text: What starts as slight adjustments escalates. Each quarter needs bigger tricks to maintain the illusion.

climax.text: Earnings management is the gateway drug to fraud. The slope from 'creative' to criminal is slippery.

punchline.text: Smooth the numbers a little. Then more. Then it's fraud.

quiz.question: What is earnings management?
options: Using legal flexibility to smooth financial results
Always illegal manipulation of financial statements
